Frequently Asked Questions

Where do India and Pakistan stand in the Group A points table?

India and Pakistan remain locked in a tight battle for the top two spots in Group A. India's recent result positions them closer to securing qualification, while Pakistan's remaining fixtures will determine their tournament destiny.

How is Net Run Rate (NRR) calculated if points are tied?

If teams finish with equal points, NRR is the primary tiebreaker. It is calculated by dividing the total runs scored by total overs faced, then subtracting the total runs conceded divided by total overs bowled across all tournament matches.

How many teams from Group A qualify for the semifinals?

Only the top two teams from Group A advance to the knockout semifinals, making every single match critical in deciding the final standings.
